innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer pool, the memory area where InnoDB caches table and index data.

innodb_log_file_size.description: The size in bytes of each log file in a log group.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls the balance between strict ACID compliance for commit operations and higher performance that is possible when commit-related I/O operations are rearranged and done in batches.

sync_binlog.description: Controls how often the MySQL server synchronizes the binary log to disk.

innodb_thread_concurrency.description: Defines the maximum number of threads permitted inside of InnoDB.

tmp_table_size.description: The maximum size of internal in-memory temporary tables.

max_heap_table_size.description: This variable sets the maximum size to which user-created MEMORY tables are permitted to grow.

innodb_io_capacity.description: The innodb_io_capacity variable defines the number of I/O operations per second (IOPS) available to InnoDB background tasks, such as flushing pages from the buffer pool and merging data from the change buffer.

innodb_io_capacity_max.description: If flushing activity falls behind, InnoDB can flush more aggressively, at a higher rate of I/O operations per second (IOPS) than defined by the innodb_io_capacity variable.

innodb_flush_method.description: Defines the method used to flush data to InnoDB data files and log files, which impacts I/O throughput. Note: 'littlesync' and 'nosync' are for internal testing only.

table_open_cache.description: The number of open tables for all threads.

table_open_cache_instances.description: The number of open tables cache instances.

innodb_read_io_threads.description: The number of I/O threads for read operations in InnoDB.

innodb_write_io_threads.description: The number of I/O threads for write operations in InnoDB.

sort_buffer_size.description: Each session that must perform a sort allocates a buffer of this size.

innodb_purge_threads.description: The number of background threads devoted to the InnoDB purge operation.

innodb_adaptive_flushing.description: Specifies whether to dynamically adjust the rate of flushing dirty pages in the InnoDB buffer pool based on the workload.

innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct.description: InnoDB tries to flush data from the buffer pool so that the percentage of dirty pages does not exceed this value.

innodb_lru_scan_depth.description: A parameter that influences the algorithms and heuristics for the flush operation for the InnoDB buffer pool.

innodb_adaptive_hash_index_parts.description: Partitions the adaptive hash index search system.

thread_cache_size.description: How many threads the server should cache for reuse.

innodb_stats_on_metadata.description: This option only applies when optimizer statistics are configured to be non-persistent.

innodb_log_buffer_size.description: The size in bytes of the buffer that InnoDB uses to write to the log files on disk.

join_buffer_size.description: The minimum size of the buffer that is used for plain index scans, range index scans, and joins that do not use indexes and thus perform full table scans.

innodb_read_ahead_threshold.description: Controls the sensitivity of linear read-ahead that InnoDB uses to prefetch pages into the buffer pool.
